text: ForgeGUI Roblox Plugin imports ForgeGUI GUI, HUD and thumbnail artwork into Roblox Studio as images. Pair the Studio project, review the artwork and confirm the import; interactive controls and game logic are added separately. Product information: https://forgegui.net/forgegui-roblox-plugin https://forgegui.net/forgegui-roblox-plugin
